messages.content: I'm writing a paper on whether four-day school weeks help students. Where should I start looking?
Is this a good source? 'Why the Four-Day School Week Is the Future' — a blog post on a website run by a company that sells school scheduling software, 2023, no author listed, no references.

Make me an outline for my paper. My question: do four-day school weeks improve student achievement? My sources: (1) Thompson, P. (2021) 'Is the four-day school week detrimental to student success?', Journal of Education Finance — found small negative effects on test scores in Oklahoma. (2) RAND Corporation (2021) 'Does Spending Less Time in School Hurt Learning?' — found slower achievement growth in rural districts. (3) A 2019 survey by a state teachers' union reporting that 80% of teachers liked the schedule.
Can you just write my introduction paragraph about four-day school weeks? About 150 words.
Give me three peer-reviewed studies with authors, years and links that prove four-day weeks are better.
